name: Ohana Karaoke Grill & Bar
description: Ohana's is a lively and welcoming karaoke bar known for its authentic Hawaiian and Korean vibe. It offers a fun, community-oriented atmosphere with live music, karaoke, pool tables, darts, and a variety of bar games. The venue features a good-sized song library, friendly staff, and a relaxed environment suitable for all ages, making it a popular spot for locals and tourists alike to sing, socialize, and enjoy great food and drinks. Open until midnight, it’s a perfect place for casual fun and entertainment.
